skill.summary: Turn an X/Twitter/LinkedIn post (URL or pasted thread text) into a talking-head video that delivers the take. Use when a creator wants to repurpose a viral p...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of revid-tweet-to-talking-head.
- Converts X/Twitter or LinkedIn posts (URL or pasted thread) into talking-head videos with avatar, voiceover, and captions.
- Supports both direct text input and post URLs, with a preference for pasted thread text to avoid scraping issues.
- Customizable options for avatar, aspect ratio, video duration, and voice.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance for common failure modes and links to related skills.
